title: Design of a Deep Learning Credit Risk Early Warning System Integrating Multi-source Heterogeneous Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.15744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advancements in data fusion and real-time analytics technologies have opened new avenues for addressing complex domain challenges. Financial risk early warning systems often suffer from inefficiency due to information silos and monitoring delays. This paper proposes a credit risk early warning system based on heterogeneous information fusion. The system employs a model architecture integrating deep neural networks and attention mechanisms to extract multidimensional features from diverse data sources such as transaction behaviors and social networks, thereby establishing an early identification mechanism for corporate and individual credit risks. System testing demonstrates that this approach significantly enhances the accuracy and timeliness of risk warnings, outperforming traditional rule-based engine solutions. translated_title: 融合多源异构数据的深度学习信用风险预警系统设计
translated_abstract: 数据融合与实时分析技术的进步为解决复杂领域挑战开辟了新途径。金融风险预警系统常因信息孤岛和监控延迟而效率低下。本文提出了一种基于异构信息融合的信用风险预警系统。该系统采用融合深度神经网络与注意力机制的模型架构，从交易行为、社交网络等多种数据源中提取多维特征，从而建立针对企业和个人信用风险的早期识别机制。系统测试表明，该方法显著提升了风险预警的准确性和时效性，优于传统的基于规则的引擎解决方案。研究成果为金融风险的早期干预提供了创新性见解，对保障金融安全具有重要的实践意义。
tldr: 本文提出了一种融合深度神经网络与注意力机制的信用风险预警系统，通过整合交易行为、社交网络等多源异构数据进行多维特征提取，显著提升了金融风险预警的准确性与时效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a credit risk early warning system integrating deep neural networks and attention mechanisms, which extracts multi-dimensional features from multi-source heterogeneous data such as transaction behaviors and social networks, significantly improving the accuracy and timeliness of financial risk warnings.
